issues.recommendation: Ensure the review is run inside a valid Git repository. Initialize one with 'git init' or clone the target project before invoking the review agent.

summary: The review could not be completed because two prerequisite conditions failed: (1) there is no Git repository present at or above the current working directory, so 'HEAD' cannot be resolved to a commit, and (2) the file system root is not readable, making direct file discovery impossible. No source code was examined, so scores cannot be meaningfully assigned — all dimensions are rated 0 to explicitly signal that no review data exists rather than a passing score.
recommendations: Clone or initialize the target Git repository in the environment before running this review agent.
Verify that the agent process has read permissions on the project directory (check OS-level ACLs and container volume mounts).
If using a CI/CD pipeline, ensure the checkout step completes successfully and the working directory is set to the repository root before invoking the review.
Re-run the review against a specific, fully-resolved commit SHA (e.g., 'git rev-parse HEAD') to avoid ambiguity when the HEAD ref cannot be resolved.
Consider providing source files directly via an upload or artifact mechanism if a Git-based review is not feasible in this environment.
